text: {"name":"ble_adv_queue_select","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Returns the head entry's handle unless the oldest queued entry exceeds its per-slot timing threshold and its state field is clear, in which case it returns that oldest entry's handle.","subsystem":"ble","var_renames":{"a1":"queue_head_ref","v1":"first_queue_entry","result":"selected_handle","v3":"oldest_entry_age","v4":"current_entry","v5":"entry_timestamp","v6":"entry_age","v7":"selected_slot"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"Next queue entry pointer."},{"offset":8,"meaning":"Timestamp used to calculate the entry's age."},{"offset":26,"meaning":"Handle or slot index associated with the queue entry."},{"offset":4,"meaning":"Per-slot state field gating age-based selection."},{"offset":14,"meaning":"Per-slot timing threshold, scaled by 1024."}]}
